+        ({'year': 2000}, False),
+        ({'data': 'note'}, False),
+        ({'id': 1, 'month': 2, 'day': 9}, False),
+        ({'id': 1}, False),
+        ({}, False),
+        (None, False),

+)
+def test_patron_check_ins_validation(data, expected):
